meta.name: Felicia, Les Mille Et Une Perversions De Felicia 1975 John Roche, Batrice Harnois, Eva Khris, Marlene Myller, Mary Mendum, Nicole Daudet + Max Pecas
meta.description:
From IMDB.comPaul and Gabrielle, a young married couple, take in their neighbor's 
teenage daughter, Felicia, for a few weeks in the summer. It isn't long 
before the precocious and seductive Felicia sets her sights on the two 
of them.----Yet another movie where a gorgeous young girls moves in with a couple and immediately starts to seduce the husband. At least in this case Jean Roche's Paul is fit and attractive. Still mostly the story is a bit of wish fulfillment for the writer as everything works out in the end.
English subtitles included as separate file.
